tips.title: Protein distribution
tips.body: 0.4 g/kg (range 0.4–0.55) per meal across ≥ 4 meals, i.e. 20–40 g every 3–4 h; optional 30–40 g slow protein (casein/dairy) 30 min before sleep. Distribution is a second-order lever after total intake.

tips.title: Meal frequency
tips.body: No independent effect on body composition once calories and protein are fixed. Choose 3–5 meals, whatever fits the day.

tips.title: Around the session
tips.body: Total daily protein dominates. Eat a protein-containing meal (0.25–0.4 g/kg) within ~2 h before or ~2 h after the session; if training fasted (> 3–4 h since protein), eat 20–40 g protein + carbohydrate within 1–2 h after. Fast carb replenishment (1–1.2 g/kg/h) only when two hard sessions fall within 8 h.

tips.title: Alcohol
tips.body: ≤ 1–2 standard drinks on a training day, none within ~4 h after the session, ≤ 7 per week; ≥ 3 drinks in an evening → next-day readiness Amber and a sleep flag. 1.5 g/kg after training cut muscle protein synthesis by 24–37 %.

tips.title: Travel (1): protein anchor first
tips.body: ≥ 30–40 g protein per meal from eggs/quark/skyr/yogurt at hotel breakfast, grilled meat/fish/tofu at lunch and dinner; carry whey (25–30 g per scoop) for days with < 3 protein meals.

tips.title: Travel (2): plate rule
tips.body: At restaurants and buffets: ½ vegetables, ¼ protein, ¼ starch; sauces on the side.

tips.title: Travel (3): petrol-station kit
tips.body: Skyr, jerky, nuts (30 g portion), fruit, protein bar with ≥ 20 g protein.

tips.title: Travel (4): expect scale jumps
tips.body: Expect +0.5–1.5 kg scale weight after high-sodium restaurant days and after weekends (0.35 % within-week swing, highest Monday, lowest Friday) — do not adjust calories on those days (NUT-15).

tips.title: Travel (5): track simply
tips.body: When calorie logging is impossible, track "protein hit? yes/no" and "meals: light/normal/heavy"; the planner uses these as ordinal inputs.

tips.title: Travel (6): water while driving
tips.body: 500 mL water per 2 h of driving; coffee counts toward the SUP-02 caffeine cut-off.

tips.title: Travel (7): alcohol
tips.body: Alcohol on the road follows NUT-13.

tips.title: Your pre-workout: coffee
tips.body: Coffee 30–45 min before the session, 2 cups at most (your own routine).

tips.title: Your pre-workout: carbs
tips.body: Carbs 60–90 min before, low in fat (e.g. pancakes with jam, honey or banana); within the last 30 min only a banana or toast.

tips.title: Your post-workout: protein
tips.body: A protein meal within 1–2 h after the session (fits NUT-12: a protein meal within about 2 h either side).
